name: email
title: Email
description: Primitives for emails built with React Email: a layout with your brand and footer, a title with a sentence, a dark panel for the one thing the email is about with its value, a money value with smaller cents, a usage meter drawn as table cells, a note and a button, sections a rule opens, label and value rows with a total, and a render helper that returns the HTML and its plain-text copy.
